title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Documentation Schedule — Riverbend Charges
content:
**Schedule.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the qualifying medical debt Riverbend documents for its own charges of the 12 whole months before the documentation day is the medical debt claimed on the case, rounded half-up to the cent and never below zero.

**When the schedule documents a case.** This schedule documents a case once an income document (pay stubs, a federal tax return, a Social Security award letter, an unemployment benefit statement or a zero-income attestation), a proof of residency and a bank statement have each been accepted on it; a case lacking any of the three keeps the medical debt claimed on it.

| Accepted on the case | Documented figure |
|---|---|
| an income document, a proof of residency and a bank statement | the scheduled figure: the medical debt claimed on the case, rounded half-up to the cent, never below zero |
| any one of the three missing | the medical debt claimed on the case, kept as it is |

**Hypothetical figures.** A case carrying a claimed medical debt of 7,000.00 with all three documents accepted is documented at 7,000.00. The same case with no bank statement accepted keeps 7,000.00 as claimed.
